%w[stock generated attached].product(%w[s0 s1]).each do |origin, profile|

      raise '\''LC prefix extent/version mismatch'\'' unless finish-start == 8 && tape.byteslice(start,8).unpack1('\''Q<'\'') == 1

  end

    @root_mutated = false

    when '\''promoted-status'\''
      @summary['\''status'\''] = '\''all_types_verified'\''
      @root_mutated = true

    when '\''modified-stdout'\'' then name.end_with?('\''.stdout'\'') && !data.empty?

    when '\''modified-rowbinary'\'' then name.end_with?('\''_insert.stdin.bin'\'') && !data.empty?
    end
    if hit
      @root_mutated = true
      data = data.dup
      data.setbyte(0, data.getbyte(0) ^ 1)
    end
    data
  end
  def mutation_observed?; @root_mutated; end
end
